summary: This directory manages the retrieval of market-specific holiday schedules. It provides a structured service interface and a context-aware wrapper to supply calendar-related data for business domain operations.
responsibilities: Define service interfaces for holiday schedule retrieval
Provide a consistent mechanism to fetch market-specific holidays
Wrap holiday retrieval logic for context-aware access
relationships: The HolidayFetcher class serves as a wrapper for the HolidayFetcherService interface to integrate holiday data into the business domain.
The HolidayFetcherService provides the necessary abstraction to implement market-specific holiday retrieval logic.
designDecisions: Use of an interface to define the service contract
Wrapper pattern for contextual service access
